subject: Web Development
title: Edge Computing and the CDN Evolution
description: Learn Edge Computing and the CDN Evolution in one minute.

hook.text: CDNs served static files from the edge. Now they can run server-side code there too.

buildup.text: Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge Functions execute code in data centers near each user.

discovery.text: Response times drop from 200 milliseconds to under 20 when the server is in the same city.

twist.text: Edge functions have tight memory and time limits. Not every workload fits the model.

climax.text: Edge computing is turning the web from a centralized model to a globally distributed one.

punchline.text: The server moved to your neighborhood.

quiz.question: What is edge computing?
options: Running code close to the user
Moving to a single data center
